public_action_policy: source independent random.Random(1000003 * seed + 337).randrange(original public action count); one action stream per independent seed
original_action_source_custody: Only source-native original env.reset/env.step or original game.its_showtime/game.play; no original source modifications, no hidden-world labels/reward or source evaluator info supplied to actor.
public_history_context: Current complete original source public observation, original current announced action and previous at most TWO complete publicly seen observations and original actions (left-pad with fixed zero public frames and action byte 255 at episode start).
retrospect_alias_current: Hash complete original publicly observed current-frame bytes plus announced original action; no source-private fields.
retrospective_next: Hash complete original publicly observed NEXT-frame bytes returned by original native step.
cross_seed_evidence: Compare source event pairs ONLY if reset seeds differ. Record total matched exact public-current-action pairs and those with distinct real original next public frames, cluster pairs, whether prior two-action/public frames differ, and pairs with still identical complete two-step historical context. Never treat correlated time steps as independent science.
prerequisite_information_signal: Within each of the two independent original source families, require >=2 distinct reset-seed clusters featuring cross-seed exact-current-action and different true-next-public outcomes, and at least 1 such pair distinguished by a prior two-step public-action/observation history; otherwise DEVELOPMENT NO-GO for this strict full-input alias prerequisite. This is NOT proof of prospective predictive utility.
upper_bound_note: Different public histories in retrospect cannot itself establish that a learned model predicts outcomes; no conventional learners trained and no general causal identifiability conclusion.
evidence_reproducibility: Cross-OS and within-OS repeat exact ORIGINAL episode/action count, original source-action/public SHA digests and alias-count receipts.
complete_resource_receipt: Original native two-engine process CPU, OS peak RSS, counted public history hashed byte volume and resulting receipt bytes. Comparable resource parity not inferred between distinct engines.
original_source_licenses: Farama redistribution metadata conflict unresolved; DeepMind Pycolab original Apache-2 licensed; source artifacts are checked out separately and not bundled.
integration_G29: BLOCKED pending legitimate original-source-bound atlas and full OS regressions
